name: ajaia-docs
description: Lightweight collaborative document editor for tech teams

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
